question: Find a named completed school screening of Lipika Singh Darai’s The Waterfall.

sources.title: First International Kids Films Festival On India [IKFFI] In ABHYASA
sources.source_type: School-authored retrospective report, retrieved as indexed original-domain text
sources.inspection: Full indexed article text read via web search. Live original domain did not resolve in browser/curl and returned403 to web open; no original page pixels or archived copy retrieved.
sources.finding: Abhyasa reports a festival on14–19November2017. It lists The Waterfall among senior titles and Lipika Singh Darai among Indian directors, in separate lists. It describes post-film discussions led by teachers or senior students and a written review project.
limitations: No explicit title/director pair, screening date within festival, or version/language for this film.
Festival grades4–12 are not film-specific attendance.
Descriptions of enjoyment or success are school testimony, not measured learning.
